summary: Keeps the Domain graph for the launcher and adopted repository navigation. Requires every Domain in a registry of two or more to participate in at least one relation, leaves applies_to_domain_ids optional, warns before it refuses under a --strict flag, and carries the validator into each Product repository. Navigation adoption is separate: coarse navigation retains named legacy gaps with changed-path advisories; complete navigation requires zero file gaps and resolved source-catalog, contract, law-clause, control, and check references without granting execution authority or behavioral proof.
title: The Domain graph earns its place through an authoring obligation
